findings.what: Seven per category counts (22, 16, 12, 12, 18, 12, 4), capacities and ranges are marked dummy in copy.ts and show as facts. README allows no numbers beyond the company's own claims; only the total 96 is from the brief.
Primary fill is #a00020, README token linde-red is #aa0020. The comment cites the guideline but no README ruling sets it.
24/7 is an invented figure marked dummy, not in the brief, against the README rule on number claims.

findings.where: Top row and footer nav Novi vs P beat Prodaja
findings.what: Glossary term is Prodaja for nav, P beat and footer, but the nav and footer say Novi while the P beat says Prodaja.
All 7 product cells link to the same URL SITE/viljuskari/, so the real links ruling (taste 12:10) is not met.
After the story the switcher is opacity 0 and pointer-events none, but its 3 buttons stay in the Tab order with no visible focus.
Button min-height 48px and the .tab row 56px are off the allowed control heights 32 to 44, base-override.json is empty.
Off scale font sizes 46px (Servis number), 74px, 54px and 41px. Servis figure at 46 and 41 differs from the 40px spec row figures.
Glossary bars Održavanje as a section name, the N row uses it as a figure.
On hover the number span is #a1a1a1 on #6b6b6b, 2.4 to 1.
